name: Model Privacy & Extraction Attacks
description: Assessment of ML model confidentiality against extraction, inversion, and membership inference attacks. Covers evaluating whether models leak training data, can be replicated through API access, or reveal information about their training set membership.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to model privacy attack concepts

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands how ML models can leak information about their training data or be stolen
evidence: Can explain model extraction, model inversion, and membership inference at a conceptual level
Aware of why model confidentiality matters for intellectual property and data privacy
Familiar with the ATLAS techniques for ML model access and exfiltration

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can execute known privacy attacks against models under guidance
evidence: Performs model extraction attacks via query access in controlled settings
Runs membership inference tools against target models
Documents model privacy findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses model confidentiality and quantifies privacy risks
evidence: Evaluates API-accessible models for extraction feasibility and query budget requirements
Assesses membership inference risk given model type and deployment context
Tests effectiveness of differential privacy, output perturbation, and rate limiting defenses
Produces model privacy assessment reports with quantified risk and practical mitigations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex model deployments; develops privacy evaluation methodology; mentors others
evidence: Evaluates privacy risks across multi-model systems and ensemble deployments
Designs privacy assessment strategies for novel model architectures
Reviews and calibrates model privacy assessments across the team
Develops internal tooling for automated privacy evaluation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines model privacy assessment practice; publishes research
evidence: Established the lab's model privacy and extraction assessment methodology
Published research on model privacy attacks, defenses, or quantification
Trains teams on model privacy assessment
Contributes to external standards on ML privacy and data protection

assessment_methods.description: Given API access to a target model, attempt extraction and membership inference, then assess deployed defenses
Review model privacy assessment reports for attack depth, defense evaluation, and actionable recommendations
